blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Friday said no Filipino should praise Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan, disagreeing with Sen. Robin Padilla‘s favorable assessment of the envoy amid calls for his expulsion over remarks about China’s possible use of force against the Philippines. “Walang Pilipino dapat ang pumuri dyan sa tao na yan kaya bagamat ganun ang sinabi ng ating senador ako ay tutol sa pagpuri dyan sa tao na yan,” Teodoro said in a virtual interview with reporters. (No Filipino should praise that person. Although our senator said that, I oppose praising that person.) Teodoro was asked about […]... Keep on reading: Teodoro opposes Sen.
